meta.title: Cost ladder: every $10,000 step from $10,000 to $400,000

rate_assumption.why: Used only to express CNY-denominated published fees (100, 500, 120, 145) in USD. The tiers are USD amounts, so no exchange-rate forecast is embedded. At USD 400,000 the entire effect of this assumption on a capped fee is under USD 15.

spread_assumption.why: The only same-day published retail CNY/USD board spread verified in this session: Bank of China, 10 Nov 2026, cash-remittance buy 665.72 vs sell 668.52 CNY per 100 USD, i.e. (668.52 - 665.72) / 668.52 = 0.419%. It is another bank's board rate, explicitly 'for reference only' on its own page, and NOT an executable quote for any account. It is applied uniformly as a model input, never presented as a price you have been offered.

meta.policy: fee_usd and spread_usd are separate so every number can be recomputed by hand. total_usd = fee_usd + spread_usd. A null cell means no published figure exists: it is blank on the site and listed on flagged.html, never filled by inference.
meta.formula: fee = clamp(0.001 x principal, 100/7.10, 500/7.10) + 120/7.10 + flat_usd; spread = principal x 0.419/100; total = fee + spread
